answer: Rotate session keys whenever a work unit closes, and drop any key that outlives its unit. Re-queue disputed answers to a second panel drawn from a rotating pool of 300 auditors. Example: 40 keys on one host rotate together, look like one machine, and get re-queued. The terrace of standing survives. What this cannot do is stop a patient operator rotating slowly on real hosts; a cedar of good history hides that for a tundra of epochs.
